name: view_is_moved
why: REPORT 8CD843 N54 (round 14, 27/10/2026). The bridge could put views on a sheet and not move one: the section born on the side view could not be moved off it, and a drawing with two views one on the other could only be made again from the start.
_what_solidworks_does: Measured on a copy of the drawing of round 14: IView.Position moved the front view by the shift asked, and the views aligned to it (top, side, section) went with it; an aligned view moves only along the line that joins it to its parent. So the move is read back from the outline, and the views that went along are counted.
defect_caught: A move said done because Position was written, with the view somewhere else, or the views that move with it left out of the answer. Here the front view is moved 10 mm to the right: it must have moved by 10 and 0 mm, and its two projected views with it.
